_COMMENT_FILE_PATH: SAVE THIS FILE AS: config_dryrun_futures_x8.json — in the ROOT of your NostalgiaForInfinity repo (same folder as config_dryrun_futures.json). NOT inside user_data/, NOT inside configs/.
_COMMENT_purpose: X8 FUTURES dry-run (OKX). Deliberately IDENTICAL to config_dryrun_futures.json in every functional setting (trading_mode/margin_mode, exchange, pairlist chain incl. lookback_days, refresh periods, stake/wallet, max_open_trades, pricing, timeframe, telegram notification settings) so the only variable between the two bots is the strategy (NostalgiaForInfinityX8 vs NostalgiaForInfinityX7ML). ONLY these differ: bot_name, db_url, and the Telegram bot/token used by the workflow. If you change ANY functional setting in one file, change it in the other too, or the comparison stops being valid. dry_run stays true — no real orders are ever placed.
_COMMENT_restart_architecture: Runs under its own self-queueing GitHub Actions chain (dry-run-telegram-futures-x8.yml). db_url below is local SQLite, persisted across restarts via its own git branch (state-futures-x8). Nothing is shared with the X7ML bots.
_COMMENT_position_adjustment: Same as the X7ML config: position_adjustment_enable=true, as the NFI strategies' Grinding/Buyback systems require it.
_COMMENT_leverage: Leverage is set inside the strategy file itself (NostalgiaForInfinityX8.py), not here — this config only turns futures mode on. Unlike X7ML (default 3.0x), X8's leverage value has not been verified here; check it in the X8 source before comparing leveraged profit figures.

exchange.name: okx
exchange._COMMENT_password: OKX's API requires a passphrase (the 'password' field) in addition to key/secret. Left empty here since dry-run never calls authenticated endpoints for real trading — only public market-data endpoints are used to simulate trades.

_COMMENT_pairlist: Identical to config_dryrun_futures.json: both VolumePairList entries need lookback_days=1 because OKX's futures/swap ticker does not expose quoteVolume in the live-ticker format (candle-based 'advanced mode' volume is required). Do not change one file without the other.
_COMMENT_telegram: token/chat_id below are dummy placeholders satisfying the config schema. The REAL values are injected at runtime via FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__TOKEN / FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__CHAT_ID environment variables — for this bot the token comes from the TELEGRAM_TOKEN_FUTURES_X8 secret (its OWN dedicated Telegram bot; sharing a token between two running freqtrade instances causes telegram.error.Conflict). Never commit real credentials into this file.
_COMMENT_db_url: Local SQLite, its own file — restored from / saved to the state-futures-x8 branch by the workflow. Never shared with the X7ML futures bot's tradesv3.dryrun_futures.sqlite.
